data.name: Bloodline Powers
data.description: One of the four elements infuses your being, and you can draw upon its power while bloodraging. At 1st level, you must select an element: air, earth, fire, or water. Once chosen, this element cannot be changed. A number of your abilities deal damage and grant resistances based on your element.
